subject.title: fix(gateway): count pending restarts toward maxRestartsPerHour budget

question: Should maxRestartsPerHour remain a strict cap on startChannel calls, or may a pending recovery use one unrecorded completion call per rolling window?
rationale: The PR fixes the bypass but intentionally makes the configured maximum non-literal; tests can verify either implementation, but they cannot decide the public configuration contract or acceptable availability tradeoff.

options.title: Keep the configured cap strict
options.body: Count every startChannel invocation and revise the pending-recovery state flow so no hidden max-plus-one exception is permitted.

options.title: Approve restart-cycle semantics
options.body: Treat the completion call as part of the already-admitted logical restart, then document the exception and require real upgrade and rollover proof.

recommendation.title: Keep the configured cap strict
recommendation.body: Count every startChannel invocation and revise the pending-recovery state flow so no hidden max-plus-one exception is permitted.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent channel-health policy refactor and broader gateway history make this the strongest available owner signal for defining the restart-budget contract.
